import pandas as pd

# Read all PostIds from the database for posts with ViewCount 100-150
import sqlite3

conn = sqlite3.connect('db/posts.db')
qualifying_postids_query = """
SELECT Id FROM posts WHERE ViewCount BETWEEN 100 AND 150
"""
qualifying_postids_df = pd.read_sql_query(qualifying_postids_query, conn)
qualifying_postids = set(qualifying_postids_df['Id'].tolist())
conn.close()

print(f"Total qualifying PostIds: {len(qualifying_postids)}")

# Read comments CSV
df = pd.read_csv('csv/comments.csv')

# Filter comments by qualifying PostIds
filtered = df[df['PostId'].isin(qualifying_postids)]

print(f"Total comments on qualifying posts: {len(filtered)}")

# Find the comment(s) with the maximum Score
max_score = filtered['Score'].max()
top_comments = filtered[filtered['Score'] == max_score]

print(f"Maximum Score among qualifying comments: {max_score}")
print(f"Number of comments with max score: {len(top_comments)}")

if len(top_comments) > 0:
    top_comment = top_comments.iloc[0]
    print(f"\nTop comment details:")
    print(f"  Id: {top_comment['Id']}")
    print(f"  PostId: {top_comment['PostId']}")
    print(f"  Score: {top_comment['Score']}")
    print(f"  Text: {top_comment['Text']}")
else:
    print("No comments found!")
